target_beneficiary: Small and Marginal Farmers across India
benefit_details: Provides income support of Rs 6,000 per year in three equal installments of Rs 2,000 directly transferred to farmers bank accounts (Direct Benefit Transfer - DBT).
eligibility_criteria: Landholding farmer families with cultivable landholding up to 2 hectares in official land records. Excludes high-income taxpayers and institutional landholders.
how_to_apply: Apply online at pmkisan.gov.in portal, via PM-KISAN mobile app, or through nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) with Aadhaar card and land record documents.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Landholding Ownership Certificate (Khasra/Khatauni), Bank Account Passbook linked with Aadhaar.

target_beneficiary: All farmers growing notified crops in notified areas including sharecroppers and tenant farmers
benefit_details: Comprehensive crop insurance cover against yield losses caused by natural non-preventable risks such as drought, flood, dry spells, pest attacks, and landslides.
eligibility_criteria: Maximum premium paid by farmer is 2% for Kharif crops, 1.5% for Rabi crops, and 5% for Annual Commercial/Horticultural crops. Remaining premium is subsidized by State and Central Governments.
how_to_apply: Enroll through PMFBY portal (pmfby.gov.in), bank branches, insurance company agents, or CSC centers before crop cutoff dates.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook, Land Sowing Certificate, Land Ownership/Tenancy Agreement.

target_beneficiary: Farmers, Tenant Farmers, Sharecroppers, Self Help Groups (SHGs), Animal Husbandry and Fisheries Farmers
benefit_details: Provides timely short-term credit loans for agricultural inputs (seeds, fertilizers, pesticides), post-harvest expenses, and farm maintenance at an effective interest rate of 4% per annum (with 3% prompt repayment incentive).
eligibility_criteria: All individual or joint borrower farmers cultivating land or engaged in animal husbandry and fisheries.
how_to_apply: Submit KCC application form at any commercial bank, Regional Rural Bank (RRB), or Cooperative Bank branch.
documents_required: Identity Proof (Aadhaar/Voter ID), Address Proof, Land Revenue Records, Passport photo.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY) & Per Drop More Crop
target_beneficiary: Farmers seeking micro-irrigation systems (Drip and Sprinkler Irrigation)
benefit_details: Financial assistance and subsidies ranging from 45% to 55% for installing Drip and Sprinkler irrigation systems to improve water use efficiency.
eligibility_criteria: Farmers owning land with an available water source (tube well, pond, or canal connection).
how_to_apply: Apply through the State Agriculture/Horticulture Department portal or local District Agriculture Office.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Land Ownership Papers, Bank Passbook, Soil and Water Test Report.

target_beneficiary: All landholding farmers across Indian states
benefit_details: Provides a customized Soil Health Card containing status of 12 soil nutrients (N, P, K, S, Zn, Fe, Cu, Mn, Bo, pH, EC, OC) and specific crop-wise fertilizer dosage recommendations.
eligibility_criteria: Issued free of cost every 3 years after soil sample collection and testing at government soil testing laboratories.
how_to_apply: Soil samples are collected by agriculture department officials from farmer fields, or farmers can submit samples at local Soil Testing Labs.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card and Land Survey Number (Khasra Number).

target_beneficiary: Small and Marginal Farmers aged 18 to 40 years
benefit_details: A voluntary pension scheme providing a minimum assured pension of Rs 3,000 per month after reaching the age of 60 years.
eligibility_criteria: Small and marginal farmers holding up to 2 hectares of cultivable land, aged 18 to 40 years. Monthly contribution ranges from Rs 55 to Rs 200 based on entry age.
how_to_apply: Enroll at nearest CSC center or self-register on pmkmy.gov.in portal.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card and Savings Bank Account Passbook linked with Aadhaar.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri KUSUM Yojana (PM-KUSUM Component A, B, C)
target_beneficiary: Individual Farmers, Panchayats, Cooperatives, Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs)
benefit_details: Provides up to 60% subsidy for setting up standalone solar agriculture pumps (Component B) and solarizing existing grid-connected agriculture pumps (Component C), plus earning extra income by selling surplus solar power back to the DISCOM grid.
eligibility_criteria: Farmers having agricultural land with need for irrigation pumps.
how_to_apply: Apply online on State Renewable Energy Development Agency portal (e.g. UPNEDA, HAREDA, MAHADISCOM).
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Land Ownership Records, Bank Passbook, Electricity Bill (for grid connected pumps).

target_beneficiary: Farmers, APMC Mandi Traders, Commission Agents, Farmer Producer Organizations
benefit_details: Pan-India electronic trading portal integrating agricultural APMC mandis to enable transparent online bidding, real-time market price discovery, and direct online payment into farmer bank accounts.
eligibility_criteria: Free online registration for any farmer selling agricultural produce at registered e-NAM mandis.
how_to_apply: Register online at enam.gov.in portal or via e-NAM mobile app with mandi gate registration.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Bank Account Details, Mobile Number.

scheme_name: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM) & Custom Hiring Centres
target_beneficiary: Farmers, FPOs, Rural Youth, Custom Hiring Centre Entrepreneurs
benefit_details: Subsidies ranging from 40% to 80% for purchasing agricultural machinery (tractors, rotavators, combine harvesters, power tillers) and setting up Custom Hiring Centres (CHCs).
eligibility_criteria: Small, marginal, women, and SC/ST farmers get higher subsidy priority.
how_to_apply: Apply online at agrimachinery.nic.in portal or via FARMS mobile app.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook, Land Ownership Proof, Caste Certificate (if applicable).

scheme_name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY) & Organic Farming
target_beneficiary: Farmers forming clusters of 20 or more hectares for organic farming
benefit_details: Financial assistance of Rs 50,000 per hectare over 3 years for organic inputs, organic seed procurement, vermicomposting, certification, and eco-friendly packaging.
eligibility_criteria: Farmers willing to adopt organic farming in clusters of 50 or more farmers covering 50 acres.
how_to_apply: Contact District Agriculture Officer or Regional Executive Agency under PKVY scheme.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Land Records, Cluster Group Registration Form.

scheme_name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)
target_beneficiary: Rural adult households willing to do unskilled manual work
benefit_details: Guarantees 100 days of wage employment per financial year to rural households, including farm asset creation, farm pond construction, bunding, and land development.
eligibility_criteria: Adult members of any rural household residing in Gram Panchayat area.
how_to_apply: Apply for Job Card at local Gram Panchayat office.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Ration Card, Bank/Post Office Savings Account Passbook, Passport photo.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises (PMFME)
target_beneficiary: Individual Micro Food Processing Units, SHGs, FPOs, Cooperatives
benefit_details: Credit-linked capital subsidy of 35% of eligible project cost up to a maximum of Rs 10 Lakh for upgrading food processing units (milling, jaggery, spice grinding, pickles).
eligibility_criteria: Existing or new micro food processing enterprises with owner aged above 18 years.
how_to_apply: Apply online on pmfme.mofpi.gov.in portal.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Business Project Report, Bank Passbook, GST/FSSAI (if applicable).

target_beneficiary: Farmers, FPOs, PACS (Primary Agricultural Credit Societies), Agri-Entrepreneurs
benefit_details: Medium-to-long term debt financing for post-harvest infrastructure (cold stores, warehouses, sorting/grading units) with 3% interest subvention per annum up to Rs 2 Crore.
eligibility_criteria: Entities setting up eligible post-harvest agricultural management infrastructure.
how_to_apply: Submit loan application online at agriinfra.dac.gov.in portal.
documents_required: Entity Registration, Detailed Project Report (DPR), Land Lease/Ownership Document, Bank Account Details.

scheme_name: Rastriya Krishi Vikas Yojana (RKVY-RAFTAAR) & Agri-Startup Incubation
target_beneficiary: Agri-Startups, Incubatees, Innovative Farmers
benefit_details: Grant-in-aid funding up to Rs 5 Lakh for pre-idea stage and up to Rs 25 Lakh for seed stage agri-enterprises and innovation startups.
eligibility_criteria: Startups working in agriculture, allied sectors, food processing, or farm technology.
how_to_apply: Apply through designated RKVY Agribusiness Incubators (RABIs) across India.
documents_required: Pitch Deck, Company Registration, Aadhaar Card, Financial Statements.

target_beneficiary: Fish Farmers, Fishers, Fish Vendors, Fisheries Cooperatives
benefit_details: Financial assistance and 40% to 60% subsidy for fish pond construction, biofloc fish farming, cage culture, motor boats, cold chain vehicles, and fish hatcheries.
eligibility_criteria: Individual fishers, fish farmers, SC/ST/Women fishers get higher 60% subsidy.
how_to_apply: Submit proposal to District Fisheries Office or online via pmmsy.dof.gov.in portal.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Land/Pond Document, Bank Passbook, Fisheries License.

target_beneficiary: All farmers growing food crops, oilseeds, and selected commercial/horticultural crops in notified areas
benefit_details: Comprehensive crop insurance coverage against yield losses caused by natural calamities (drought, flood, hailstorm, cyclone), pests, and diseases. Subsidized premiums for small and marginal farmers. Claims directly transferred to farmer bank accounts.
eligibility_criteria: All farmers growing notified crops in notified areas and seasons. Coverage for sowing/planting risk, standing crop losses, post-harvest losses, and localized risks like hailstorms and landslides.
how_to_apply: Report crop losses to local agriculture office or insurer within 48 hours of the incident. Assessment by joint team of local authorities and insurance company.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Land Ownership/Tenancy Document, Crop Sowing Certificate, Bank Passbook.

scheme_name: National Food Security and Nutrition Mission (NFSM)
target_beneficiary: Farmers growing rice, wheat, pulses, millets (Shree Anna), coarse cereals, sugarcane, jute across 28 States and 2 UTs
benefit_details: Financial assistance through States for demonstrations on improved crop production technologies, distribution of certified seeds of notified varieties, Integrated Nutrient Management (INM) and Integrated Pest Management (IPM) interventions, and cropping system-based training programmes.
eligibility_criteria: Farmers in districts identified by State governments having relatively low productivity but high production potential for target crops.
how_to_apply: Contact District Agriculture Officer or State Agriculture Department. Seed minikits distributed through central and state seed agencies.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Land Records, Bank Account Details.

target_beneficiary: Farmers willing to adopt chemical-free natural farming practices across India
benefit_details: Financial assistance for on-farm input production infrastructure with total outlay of Rs 2,481 crore. Covers 7.5 lakh hectares, 15,000 clusters, 10,000 Bio-Input Resource Centres (BRCs). Provides continuous hand-holding, easy certification for chemical-free produce, and a National Logo for naturally grown products.
eligibility_criteria: Any farmer willing to adopt natural farming practices integrating livestock with diversified crop systems using local cow breeds.
how_to_apply: Contact local Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK), District Agriculture Officer, or State Agriculture Department for enrollment in natural farming clusters.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Land Records, Bank Passbook.

target_beneficiary: Coconut growers across all coconut-growing States in India
benefit_details: Insurance coverage for healthy nut-bearing coconut palms (age 4-60 years) against natural perils including storm, cyclone, flood, pest/disease, accidental fire, earthquake, landslide, tsunami, and severe drought leading to death or loss of palm.
eligibility_criteria: All healthy bearing coconut palms (Tall variety 7-60 years, Dwarf/Hybrid 4-60 years) grown as mono or intercropped. Unhealthy and senile palms excluded.
how_to_apply: Apply through Agriculture Insurance Company representatives or local Coconut Development Board (CDB) office in cluster villages.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Land Ownership Document, Palm Count Certificate, Bank Passbook.

target_beneficiary: Agriculture graduates, graduates in allied subjects (Horticulture, Sericulture, Veterinary Sciences, Forestry, Dairy, Poultry, Fisheries) seeking to set up agri-enterprises
benefit_details: Start-up training for agriculture graduates to establish Agri-Clinics providing professional extension services to farmers. Special start-up loans available through NABARD for ventures after completing training.
eligibility_criteria: Fresh or experienced graduates in agriculture or any allied subject. Currently employed or unemployed candidates eligible.
how_to_apply: Apply online at acabcmis.gov.in portal. Training conducted by designated Nodal Training Institutes (NTIs) across India. Helpline: 9951851556.
documents_required: Graduation Certificate in Agriculture/Allied Subject, Aadhaar Card, Bank Account Details, Project Report.

scheme_name: SVAMITVA Yojana (Survey of Villages and Mapping with Improvised Technology in Village Areas)
target_beneficiary: Rural household owners in village inhabited (Abadi) areas across India
benefit_details: Provides Record of Rights and legal ownership cards (Property Cards/Title Deeds) to rural property owners by mapping land parcels using drone technology. Enables rural property to become bankable assets for loans. Over 1.46 lakh villages have received distributed cards.
eligibility_criteria: All rural households in Gram Panchayat areas where drone survey has been completed and maps verified by State Revenue Department.
how_to_apply: Property cards distributed through Gram Panchayat after drone survey completion and Gram Sabha verification. Check status at svamitva.nic.in.
documents_required: Existing property documents (if available), Aadhaar Card, Gram Panchayat residence proof.

target_beneficiary: Farmers, individual entrepreneurs, SHGs, dairy cooperative societies, FPOs, Panchayati Raj institutions involved in small ruminant, poultry, piggery, and fodder sectors
benefit_details: Subsidies and financial assistance for entrepreneurship development in sheep, goat, poultry, and piggery farming. Covers breed improvement, feed and fodder development, and innovation. Priority given to SC/ST/women/BPL/small and marginal farmers.
eligibility_criteria: Eligible beneficiaries include farmers, individual entrepreneurs, and organized sector groups. More than one family member can be assisted if units are at separate locations (minimum 500m apart).
how_to_apply: Apply online at nlm.udyamimitra.in portal. Applications processed through Commercial Banks, Cooperative Banks, and Regional Rural Banks eligible for NABARD refinance.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook, Land/Shed Document, Project Report, Caste Certificate (if applicable).

target_beneficiary: Houseless rural households and households living in kutcha/dilapidated houses identified through SECC 2011 data
benefit_details: Financial assistance of Rs 1,20,000 per unit for plain areas and Rs 1,30,000 for hilly/difficult areas. Optional loan up to Rs 70,000 at 3% lower interest. Minimum house size 25 sq m with dedicated cooking area. Additional Rs 12,000 for toilet (via SBM-G), 95 days MGNREGA employment, and free LPG connection (via Ujjwala).
eligibility_criteria: Beneficiaries identified using Housing Deprivation Parameters from SECC 2011, verified by Gram Sabhas. Must be houseless or living in kutcha/dilapidated house.
how_to_apply: Beneficiary list prepared by Gram Sabha from SECC data. Check status at pmayg.dord.gov.in. Payments made electronically to Aadhaar-linked bank/post office accounts.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, SECC Inclusion Certificate, Bank/Post Office Account Passbook linked with Aadhaar, Land Document (if available).

target_beneficiary: Farmers, individual entrepreneurs, SHGs, dairy cooperative societies, producer companies seeking to establish dairy units
benefit_details: Back-ended capital subsidy of 25% of project cost (33.33% for SC/ST farmers) for establishing small dairy units (2-10 crossbred/indigenous cows), rearing heifer calves, purchasing milking machines/bulk milk cooling units, dairy processing equipment, cold storage, transportation, and veterinary clinics.
eligibility_criteria: All individual or group borrower farmers. Priority to SC/ST/women/landless/small and marginal/BPL farmers and drought area farmers. Minimum entrepreneur contribution of 10% for loans above Rs 1.6 lakh.
how_to_apply: Submit project proposal to any Commercial Bank, Cooperative Bank, or Regional Rural Bank eligible for NABARD refinance. NABARD is the Nodal Agency.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook, Detailed Project Report (DPR), Land/Shed Document, Caste Certificate (if applicable), Veterinary Health Certificate for animals.

target_beneficiary: Small and marginal farmers, landless labourers owning indigenous bovine breeds (cattle and buffalo) across India
benefit_details: 100% grant-in-aid for genetic upgradation of bovine population through AI coverage, breed improvement using sex-sorted semen, IVF technology, and genomics. 50% assistance on cost of sex-sorted semen. 3% interest subvention on loans for high genetic merit (HGM) IVF-born heifers. 35% capital cost assistance for Heifer Rearing Centres. Total outlay Rs 3,400 crore.
eligibility_criteria: All farmers with indigenous bovine breeds. Over 70% of livestock farming work undertaken by women, so special focus on women farmers.
how_to_apply: Contact local veterinary/animal husbandry office or AI technician (MAITRI) for artificial insemination services. Apply through State Animal Husbandry Department.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Cattle/Buffalo ownership proof, Bank Passbook, Bharat Pashudhan app registration.

target_beneficiary: Beekeepers, farmers, landless labourers, SHGs, FPOs, agri-entrepreneurs involved in apiculture across India
benefit_details: Financial assistance for scientific beekeeping with total budget outlay of Rs 500 crore. Covers bee colony distribution, honey testing labs, disease diagnostic labs, processing units, custom hiring centres, packaging and cold storage. Formation of 100 FPOs of beekeepers. India is now 2nd largest honey exporter globally.
eligibility_criteria: Any farmer, landless labourer, SHG, FPO, or entrepreneur willing to adopt scientific beekeeping as part of integrated farming system.
how_to_apply: Register on Madhukranti portal (madhukranti.in). Apply through National Bee Board (NBB) or State Agriculture/Horticulture Department.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Land Document (if applicable), Bank Passbook, SHG/FPO Registration (if applicable).

target_beneficiary: Adult women (18+ years) from poor households without existing LPG connection
benefit_details: Deposit-free LPG connection with free pressure regulator, safety hose, first refill, and hot plate (stove). Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) subsidy of Rs 300 per 14.2 kg cylinder for eligible refills. Financial support of Rs 1,600 per connection.
eligibility_criteria: Applicant must be adult woman aged 18+. No other LPG connection in the same household. Must belong to poor household (SC/ST, PMAY, AAY beneficiaries, forest dwellers, or extreme poor per SECC data).
how_to_apply: Apply at nearest Indane/HP Gas/Bharat Gas distributor or online at pmuy.gov.in portal. Helpline: 14438 (Ujjwala) / 1906 (LPG Emergency).
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Ration Card or address proof, Bank Account Passbook, Passport-size photograph, Deprivation Declaration.

scheme_name: Jal Jeevan Mission (JJM) - Har Ghar Jal
target_beneficiary: All rural households across India seeking safe and adequate drinking water through individual tap connections
benefit_details: Provides functional household tap connections (FHTC) to all rural households. As of August 2026, 6.33 crore rural households (81.81%) connected out of 7.76 crore total. Includes source sustainability measures like rainwater harvesting, grey water management, and water conservation.
eligibility_criteria: All rural households in Gram Panchayat areas. Priority to quality-affected habitations, drought-prone areas, SC/ST majority villages, and aspirational districts.
how_to_apply: Contact local Gram Panchayat, Paani Samiti (Village Water & Sanitation Committee), or District Water & Sanitation Mission (DWSM). Track progress at ejalshakti.gov.in.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Gram Panchayat residence proof. No individual application needed in most states as connections provided village-wise.

scheme_name: Samagra Shiksha Abhiyan (SSA) - Universal School Education
target_beneficiary: Children from pre-school to Class 12 across India, especially children from farming and rural families
benefit_details: Free textbooks, uniforms, and mid-day meals (PM POSHAN) in government schools. Transport allowances for remote rural children. Sharda programme to re-enroll out-of-school children through bridge courses. Vocational training aligned with NEP 2020 including modern agricultural practices from Class 9-12. Smart classrooms and ICT labs in rural schools.
eligibility_criteria: All children aged 6-18 years enrolled in or eligible for government and government-aided schools. Special focus on SC/ST/minority/disabled/girl children from rural and farming households.
how_to_apply: Enrollment through nearest government school or Samagra Shiksha Kendra. Contact Block Education Officer or District Education Office.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card of child and parent, Birth Certificate, Previous school Transfer Certificate (if applicable), Caste Certificate (if applicable).

scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
target_beneficiary: Poor and vulnerable families across India identified through SECC 2011 data for cashless hospitalization
benefit_details: Cashless hospitalization coverage of Rs 5,00,000 per family per year for secondary and tertiary healthcare services at empanelled hospitals. Covers pre and post hospitalization expenses, diagnostics, medicines, and treatment. No cap on family size or age. Portable across India.
eligibility_criteria: Families identified as deprived under SECC 2011 categories. Covers rural families with kutcha houses, no adult earning member, female-headed households, SC/ST households, landless manual labourers, and destitute/living on alms.
how_to_apply: Check eligibility at mera.pmjay.gov.in or call Ayushman Bharat helpline 14555. Get Ayushman Card at nearest empanelled hospital or Common Service Centre (CSC).
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Ration Card, SECC inclusion letter, any government-issued ID. Ayushman Card issued free of cost.

scheme_name: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Gram Jyoti Yojana (DDUGJY)
target_beneficiary: Rural households and agricultural consumers
benefit_details: Provides continuous power supply to rural India by separating agriculture and non-agriculture feeders, and strengthening the sub-transmission and distribution network.
eligibility_criteria: All rural households, specifically focusing on un-electrified villages and BPL (Below Poverty Line) households.
how_to_apply: Implemented by State DISCOMs. BPL households can apply for free electricity connections through their local Gram Panchayat or electricity department.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, BPL Ration Card (for free connection), Residence Proof.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY)
target_beneficiary: Poor and vulnerable citizens covered under National Food Security Act (NFSA)
benefit_details: Provides 5 kg of free food grains (rice or wheat) per person per month, in addition to the regular subsidized food grains under NFSA.
eligibility_criteria: Families holding Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) and Priority Household (PHH) ration cards.
how_to_apply: No separate application needed. Beneficiaries can collect their free ration from the nearest Fair Price Shop (FPS) using their existing ration card.
documents_required: Valid Ration Card (AAY or PHH), Aadhaar linked to the ration card for biometric authentication (ePoS).

target_beneficiary: Unbanked citizens, especially in rural areas
benefit_details: Provides access to a basic savings bank account with no minimum balance requirement, a RuPay debit card, and an inbuilt accident insurance cover of Rs 2 lakh. Also allows overdraft facility up to Rs 10,000.
eligibility_criteria: Any Indian citizen above 10 years of age who does not already have a bank account.
how_to_apply: Open an account at any bank branch or Business Correspondent (Bank Mitra) outlet.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Voter ID, or any official valid document (OVD) like PAN card or MGNREGA job card.

target_beneficiary: Citizens in the unorganized sector
benefit_details: Provides a guaranteed minimum monthly pension ranging from Rs 1,000 to Rs 5,000 after the age of 60 years, depending on the contributions made.
eligibility_criteria: Any Indian citizen between 18 and 40 years of age with a savings bank account/post office savings bank account.
how_to_apply: Apply through the bank branch or post office where the individual holds a savings account, or via net banking.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Bank Account Details, Mobile Number.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
target_beneficiary: Poor and low-income section of the society
benefit_details: Provides life insurance cover of Rs 2 lakh in case of death due to any reason for an annual premium of Rs 436.
eligibility_criteria: People in the age group of 18 to 50 years having a bank account who give their consent to join/enable auto-debit.
how_to_apply: Enroll via participating banks or post offices, or through internet banking (auto-debit).
documents_required: Aadhaar Card linked to Bank Account, Consent form for auto-debit.

target_beneficiary: Poor and low-income individuals
benefit_details: Provides accidental death and full disability cover of Rs 2 lakh and Rs 1 lakh for partial disability for an annual premium of just Rs 20.
eligibility_criteria: People in the age group of 18 to 70 years with a bank/post office account who give their consent to join/enable auto-debit.
how_to_apply: Enroll via participating banks/post offices or through net banking for auto-debit.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card linked to Bank Account, Consent form for auto-debit.

scheme_name: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NRLM)
target_beneficiary: Poor rural women and marginalized communities
benefit_details: Mobilizes rural poor women into Self Help Groups (SHGs) and provides them with capital support, training, and access to financial services to start livelihood activities.
eligibility_criteria: Women from rural poor households identified through Participatory Identification of Poor (PIP) and SECC data.
how_to_apply: Approach the local Gram Panchayat or the Block Mission Management Unit (BMMU) to form or join an SHG.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Bank Account (for SHG), Residence Proof, BPL/SECC identification.

target_beneficiary: Non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises
benefit_details: Provides collateral-free loans up to Rs 10 lakh to micro-enterprises under three categories: Shishu (up to Rs 50k), Kishore (Rs 50k - 5 lakh), and Tarun (Rs 5 lakh - 10 lakh).
eligibility_criteria: Any Indian citizen who has a business plan for a non-farm sector income generating activity such as manufacturing, processing, trading or service sector.
how_to_apply: Apply at commercial banks, RRBs, Small Finance Banks, MFIs, or online through the Udyamimitra portal.
documents_required: Identity Proof (Aadhaar/Voter ID), Proof of Address, Business Plan/Project Report, Bank Statement.

target_beneficiary: Girl children in India
benefit_details: A small deposit scheme offering a high interest rate and tax benefits under Section 80C to help parents build a fund for their girl childs education and marriage.
eligibility_criteria: Parents or legal guardians can open the account for a girl child below the age of 10 years. Maximum two accounts allowed per family (one for each girl child).
how_to_apply: Open an account at any post office or authorized commercial bank branch.
documents_required: Birth Certificate of the girl child, Identity and Address Proof of the parent/guardian (Aadhaar, PAN).

target_beneficiary: Traditional artisans and craftspeople (like carpenters, blacksmiths, potters, weavers, etc.)
benefit_details: Provides PM Vishwakarma Certificate/ID card, basic/advanced skill training with stipend, collateral-free credit support up to Rs 3 lakh, toolkit incentive of Rs 15,000, and digital/marketing support.
eligibility_criteria: Artisans/craftspeople working with hands and tools in one of the 18 specified traditional trades, aged 18 years or above.
how_to_apply: Apply online through the PM Vishwakarma portal using Aadhaar authentication, or visit the nearest CSC for assistance.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Mobile Number, Bank Account Details, Ration Card (for family identification).
